laws.k: east-asia|HK|Standard Employment Contract for Domestic Helpers (ID 407)
laws.t: Standard Employment Contract for Domestic Helpers (ID 407)
laws.s1: Kontrak standar Hong Kong SAR, terakhir diubah 2016.
laws.s2: Kontrak kerja standar wajib bagi pekerja rumah tangga asing: gaji, makan, tinggal di rumah majikan, dan perawatan kesehatan.

laws.s1: Undang-undang Hong Kong SAR tahun 1953, terakhir diubah 2026.
laws.s2: Majikan wajib mengasuransikan pekerja untuk kecelakaan kerja.

laws.s1: Undang-undang Hong Kong SAR tahun 1961, terakhir diubah 2026.
laws.s2: Mengatur pembentukan dan keanggotaan serikat pekerja.

laws.s1: Undang-undang Hong Kong SAR tahun 1968, terakhir diubah 2026.
laws.s2: Mengatur upah, hari libur mingguan, hari raya, dan pemutusan kerja. Berlaku juga bagi pekerja rumah tangga asing.

laws.s1: Peraturan pelaksana Hong Kong SAR tahun 1968, terakhir diubah 2018.
laws.s2: Mengatur agen penyalur kerja. Komisi yang boleh dipungut dari pekerja paling banyak 10% dari gaji bulan pertama.

laws.k: domestic-workers|HK|Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) and the Standard Employment Contract for Foreign Domestic Helpers (ID 407)
laws.t: Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) and the Standard Employment Contract for Foreign Domestic Helpers (ID 407)
laws.tp: Rest day, leave, wage protection and maternity protection; live-in rule and minimum allowable wage by policy.
laws.s2: Hari libur, cuti, perlindungan upah, dan perlindungan kehamilan. Wajib tinggal di rumah majikan dan upah minimum khusus ditetapkan lewat kebijakan.

laws.s1: Undang-undang Hong Kong SAR tahun 1972, terakhir diubah 2025.
laws.s2: Mengatur masuk dan syarat tinggal orang asing di Hong Kong.

laws.k: east-asia|HK|Minimum Wage Ordinance (Cap. 608), s. 7 (live-in domestic workers excluded)
laws.t: Minimum Wage Ordinance (Cap. 608), s. 7 (live-in domestic workers excluded)
laws.s1: Undang-undang Hong Kong SAR tahun 2010, terakhir diubah 2026.
laws.s2: Menetapkan upah minimum. Pekerja rumah tangga yang tinggal di rumah majikan dikecualikan (Pasal 7).

coded.vl: The general labor statute applies in full
coded.n: The Employment Ordinance applies in full.

coded.vl: A separate floor applies that is lower than, or not linked to, the national minimum
coded.n: The statutory minimum wage does not apply to domestic workers who live in the household free of charge, a class wider than foreign helpers. A Minimum Allowable Wage set by government applies instead: HK$5,100 for contracts from 30 Sep 2025 and HK$5,220 for contracts signed on or after 3 Oct 2026, plus food or a food allowance.
coded.src: Minimum Wage Ordinance (Cap. 608) s. 7(3); HKSAR press releases, 29 Sep 2025 and 2 Oct 2026

coded.vl: Only minimum rest periods apply, or limits apply with sector exclusions
coded.n: No statutory limit on hours (none exists for any worker in Hong Kong); a weekly rest day and statutory holidays apply.
coded.src: Employment Ordinance Parts IV and VIII

coded.vl: May change only on listed grounds, a limited number of times or with official approval
coded.n: May change employer, but must normally leave Hong Kong within two weeks of the contract ending and apply from abroad; frequent changes are refused as 'job-hopping'.
coded.src: Immigration Department, Foreign Domestic Helpers page and guidance (official guidance)

coded.vl: May form and join unions on equal terms
coded.n: May form and join unions under the Trade Unions Ordinance.

coded.vl: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
coded.n: Agencies may charge job-seekers no more than 10% of the first month's wage.
coded.src: Employment Agency Regulations (Cap. 57A) reg. 10(2), Second Schedule Part II

coded.vl: Only employer-bought private or accident insurance is required
coded.n: Employees' compensation insurance is compulsory and the employer must provide free medical treatment; helpers are exempt from the Mandatory Provident Fund.
coded.src: Employees' Compensation Ordinance; Standard Employment Contract (ID 407) cl. 9(a)

coded.vl: A dedicated public channel for migrant workers in their languages
coded.n: Labour Department hotline and a dedicated portal for helpers in 12 languages.

coded.vl: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
coded.n: Time as a helper does not count as ordinary residence for permanent residence (Immigration Ordinance s. 2(4)(a)(vi)); upheld by the Court of Final Appeal in Vallejos (2013).
coded.src: Immigration Ordinance (Cap. 115); Vallejos v Commissioner of Registration, FACV 19/2012 (2013)

coded.vl: Barred
coded.n: Helpers may not bring dependants.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Employment Ordinance covers foreign domestic helpers; mandatory Standard Employment Contract.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Standard Employment Contract in English and Chinese, signed before the visa is granted.

coded.vl: A separate or lower minimum, or one set only by policy
coded.n: Statutory Minimum Wage excludes live-in domestic workers; a separate Minimum Allowable Wage is set by policy.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Wages within 7 days of the due date; deductions restricted.

coded.vl: No limit and no daily rest rule
coded.n: No limit on working hours.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: One rest day of at least 24 continuous hours each week.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers
coded.n: Paid annual leave of 7-14 days as for other employees.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
coded.n: Code of Practice bars agencies from keeping documents; general offence of unlawfully withholding documents.
coded.src: Code of Practice for Employment Agencies

coded.vl: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
coded.n: Mandatory live-in rule; contract requires suitable accommodation with reasonable privacy.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: May change employer on termination, but must leave within two weeks or find a new employer.

coded.vl: Fees capped
coded.n: Agencies may charge at most 10% of the first month's wage.

coded.vl: Licensing only
coded.n: Licensed agencies; 2018 amendments raised penalties.

coded.vl: Complaint-based or agency inspection only
coded.n: Complaint-based.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
coded.n: Labour Tribunal and Minor Employment Claims Adjudication Board.

coded.vl: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
coded.n: Employees' Compensation and maternity protection apply; Mandatory Provident Fund excludes helpers.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only
coded.n: General criminal law.

coded.vl: May form and join trade unions
coded.n: May form and join trade unions.

changes.en: Minimum Allowable Wage cut by 5%, from HK$3,860 to HK$3,670, citing the recession.
Minimum Allowable Wage raised to HK$5,100.
Minimum Allowable Wage raised to HK$5,220 for contracts signed from 3 October.

dec.n: Ng Ka Ling v. Director of Immigration
dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: Thousands of children in mainland China had a parent living in Hong Kong. The top court said they had the right to live in Hong Kong. Months later, an interpretation by China’s legislature limited the effect of the ruling.
dec.pi: Ribuan anak di Tiongkok daratan punya orang tua yang tinggal di Hong Kong. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka berhak tinggal di Hong Kong. Beberapa bulan kemudian, tafsir badan legislatif Tiongkok membatasi akibat putusan itu.

dec.n: Director of Immigration v. Chong Fung Yuen
dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: A boy was born in Hong Kong to parents from mainland China who were visiting. The top court said he had the right to live in Hong Kong because he was born there.
dec.pi: Seorang anak laki-laki lahir di Hong Kong dari orang tua asal Tiongkok daratan yang sedang berkunjung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan ia berhak tinggal di Hong Kong karena lahir di sana.

dec.n: Fok Chun Wa v. Hospital Authority
dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: Women from mainland China married to Hong Kong men were charged much more to give birth in public hospitals. The highest court let the higher fees stand.
dec.pi: Perempuan dari Tiongkok daratan yang menikah dengan pria Hong Kong dikenakan biaya persalinan jauh lebih tinggi di rumah sakit umum. Pengadilan tertinggi mempertahankan biaya itu.

dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: A Nigerian man who had served a prison sentence in Hong Kong feared a second prosecution at home. The top court said the protection against cruel treatment applies to deportation, but not on these facts.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Nigeria yang telah menjalani hukuman penjara di Hong Kong takut dituntut lagi di negaranya. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan perlindungan dari perlakuan kejam berlaku bagi deportasi, tetapi tidak dalam fakta ini.

dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: A domestic worker from the Philippines had worked in Hong Kong for many years. Most people who live there for seven years can become permanent residents, but the law says time as a foreign domestic helper does not count. The highest court said that rule is allowed.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga dari Filipina sudah bekerja di Hong Kong bertahun-tahun. Kebanyakan orang yang tinggal tujuh tahun di sana bisa menjadi penduduk tetap, tetapi hukum menyatakan masa kerja sebagai pekerja rumah tangga asing tidak dihitung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan aturan itu boleh.

dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: Hong Kong had left refugee claims to the UN refugee agency. The top court said the government must judge the risk itself before sending anyone away.
dec.pi: Hong Kong menyerahkan klaim pengungsi kepada badan pengungsi PBB. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan pemerintah harus menilai sendiri risikonya sebelum mengeluarkan siapa pun.

dec.n: HKSAR v. Tai Chi-wai and Catherine Au Yuk-shan (Kartika Puspitasari case)
dec.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker was abused for two years by her employers. A Hong Kong court convicted both employers and sent them to prison.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dianiaya selama dua tahun oleh majikannya. Pengadilan Hong Kong memvonis kedua majikan dan memenjarakan mereka.

dec.n: Kong Yunming v. Director of Social Welfare
dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: A woman who moved from mainland China to Hong Kong was refused welfare because she had not lived there seven years. The highest court said this rule was unconstitutional.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan yang pindah dari Tiongkok daratan ke Hong Kong ditolak bantuan sosial karena belum tinggal tujuh tahun. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan aturan itu inkonstitusional.

dec.n: GA and others v. Director of Immigration
dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: People waiting years for their protection claims in Hong Kong were not allowed to work. The highest court said they have no right to work, though the government may allow it case by case.
dec.pi: Orang yang bertahun-tahun menunggu permohonan perlindungan di Hong Kong tidak boleh bekerja. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka tidak punya hak bekerja, walau pemerintah boleh mengizinkan kasus per kasus.

dec.n: Ghulam Rbani v. Secretary for Justice
dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: A Pakistani man was held for weeks by Hong Kong immigration officers without anyone deciding whether he needed to be held. The top court said that part of his detention was unlawful.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Pakistan ditahan berminggu-minggu oleh petugas imigrasi Hong Kong tanpa ada yang memutuskan apakah ia perlu ditahan. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan sebagian penahanan itu tidak sah.

dec.n: HKSAR v. Law Wan-tung (Erwiana Sulistyaningsih case)
dec.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker was badly beaten by her employer and sent home barely able to walk. Her case caused protests. The court convicted the employer and sent her to prison for six years.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dianiaya berat oleh majikannya dan dipulangkan dalam keadaan hampir tak bisa berjalan. Kasusnya memicu protes. Pengadilan memvonis majikan dan memenjarakannya enam tahun.

dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: Former domestic workers from the Philippines and Indonesia had children who are Hong Kong permanent residents. They asked to stay to raise them. The highest court said they had no right to stay.
dec.pi: Mantan pekerja rumah tangga dari Filipina dan Indonesia punya anak yang menjadi penduduk tetap Hong Kong. Mereka meminta tinggal untuk membesarkan anak-anak itu. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka tidak berhak tinggal.

dec.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
dec.pe: A Pakistani man said he was made to work for years in Hong Kong without pay. He argued Hong Kong must have a crime of human trafficking. The highest court disagreed.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Pakistan mengaku dipaksa bekerja bertahun-tahun di Hong Kong tanpa upah. Ia berargumen Hong Kong wajib punya tindak pidana perdagangan orang. Pengadilan tertinggi tidak setuju.

dec.pe: A domestic worker challenged the rule that helpers must live with their employers, saying it leads to very long hours. Both courts said the government may keep the rule.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga menggugat aturan wajib tinggal bersama majikan, karena aturan itu membuat jam kerja sangat panjang. Kedua pengadilan menyatakan pemerintah boleh mempertahankan aturan itu.
